title: Words of Radiance
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: The second Stormlight Archive novel. A war on a broken, storm-swept plain and the fates of a soldier, a scholar and a warlord are told in alternating, deeply interior chapters.
readIf: you want a huge, immersive fantasy where character arcs and worldbuilding are equally important.
skipIf: you have not read The Way of Kings, or you have little patience for 1,000-page books.

pairings.reason: Also a long, immersive middle chapter in a larger saga, with a heavy emphasis on craft and magic.
A standalone epic of similar scale, with dragons, queens and an intricate multi-country world.
A sequel of comparable heft in which a vast cast, factions and a war structure the story.
